entries.note: The sorting centre's first scan of the parcel, in Shenzhen.
The parcel leaves the Shenzhen site for the airport.

entries.english: Handed to the airline, flight departed

entries.note: Export clearance in China, before the handover to the airline.

entries.wording: Cargo handed over to the airline

entries.note: Names the booked flight's day, read as an ellipsis, before the take-off. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
Names the day the booked flight lands, read as an ellipsis, written with the departure's note. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The flight's landing, naming the airport, read as an ellipsis, after the take-off.
Import customs at the destination, a day after the flight landed.
The import clearance done, after the customs warehouse.
Customs cleared and moving on to Germany, two days after the flight's arrival in Europe.

entries.english: Arrived in Germany, handed to the delivering carrier
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier, DHL, after the clearance; not a delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: DHL's record of the parcel's data, copied without a place, on DHL's clock in Germany.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: DHL's first scan in Germany, copied without a place, on DHL's clock there.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the export parcel center
The shipment will be transported to the destination country/destination area and, from there, handed over to the delivery organization.
entries.note: Copied from DHL in Germany, before the parcel leaves for the destination country.
